verdict.rationale: Mastra's graph-based workflow engine (.then(), .branch(), .parallel()) plus agents-as-tools and suspend/resume support give the building blocks to chain multiple agents within one workflow, and it can author MCP servers exposing agents. However, no evidence explicitly documents named multi-agent patterns like handoffs, subagents, or crews, and one community report describes workflows/branching logic as clunky in practice. Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of agent-to-agent handoff or subagent delegation patterns, and independent corroboration of smooth multi-agent orchestration.
